title: Be able to + or - delay activity time
body:
Suggestion:

When I enter carbs, I can say that it was x min earlier or will be x min later. That's great.

It would be useful to be able to input the delay for activity also. I started an activity and gorgot to input it v input activity with -x minutes (this will be just informational or may help the auto tune/adapt) or I'll start the activity in +x minutes (AAPS may inform the user the need to stop the basal and/or eat carbs).

comments.body:
Isn't activity purely a careportal note?  It has no actual bearing on the
behaviour of the algorithm AFAIK.

Yes and no ;) If you enter activity via _carbs_ menu (even without entering carbs) you can delay + or - (thus my request is no more justified ;)  ) and the target changes.
If you enter via the _activity button_ on page 2, you have no delay and no modification to the target... 
Strange that there are 2 different reactions to the same info input.

Do you mean starting the activity TT?  That's the only thing relative to
activity I see from the carbs button. Doesn't a TT only have relevance into
the future. What's happened in the past is done and changing the target for
that period won't change the behaviour of the algorithm AFAIK. I hope it
doesn't.

Adding carbs into the past makes sense because those carbs may still not be
decayed and so the remaining carbs will impact the algorithm in the future.
